notes: Rear boundary, side pressure cheeks and ceiling cassette read as one contained workshop; the faceted glass insets remain subtle and the side wall still lacks the reference's curved yacht-like reveal.
The paired articulated lift rigs establish a hero operation and clear shoulder/elbow/tool-head hierarchy, but the members remain boxy and lack premium joint housings, cables and end-effector detail.
Cabinets, drawer bands and repeated service cradles now wrap the rear and sides, although the comparison still reads sparse beside the reference's dense tool wall.
Nested rings, transverse ribs, travelling gantry and cyan practicals create multiple overhead bands; broad black panels still dominate between them.
Bronze/cyan zoning is coherent, but surfaces remain clean, flat and game-like with insufficient roughness variation, contact shadow, upholstered detail and warm practical-light hierarchy.
